geometryDeferredToAnimationFrame.finding: Geometry is animation-gated: link `d` stays "" and symbol transforms stay matrix(0,0,0,0,x,y) (scale ZERO) until a frame runs. Attribute-level checks (role / aria-label / tabindex / stroke-dasharray) ALL PASS on those empty paths — so an audit that reads attributes but never geometry certifies a chart that draws nothing. In a compositing browser this resolves within a frame and no user sees it; the hazard is to automated verification, not to readers.
geometryDeferredToAnimationFrame.ux_dr18_knob: animation:false with lazyUpdate:false renders the settled state synchronously. Same switch answers prefers-reduced-motion AND makes the engine measurable.

zeroHeightContainerThrows.reproducibility: Deterministic. This was the root cause of an INTERMITTENT uncaught TypeError on initial page load: on some loads #chart had not yet been laid out when the inline script ran.
zeroHeightContainerThrows.failureMode: an uncaught TypeError, not a graceful no-op. Under ADR 0013 there is no SVG behind the chart, so the reader gets a blank box plus a console error.
zeroHeightContainerThrows.comparison: Candidate (a) survived all three zero-size conditions and still drew 21 points.

forceLayoutDeterminism.why: The force simulation is requestAnimationFrame-driven and this pane produced 0 frames in 1200 ms. Two runs returned identical coordinates, but that is indistinguishable from both runs stalling at the same pre-settle state, so it is reported as UNMEASURED rather than as determinism.
forceLayoutDeterminism.moot: The recommended strategy is layout:'none' over generation-time coordinates, which removes client force layout entirely.

csp.latentFunctionConstructor: The one static eval-class construct is a guarded lodash-style Function("return this")() reached only if BOTH the freeGlobal and `self` checks fail. In a browser `self` short-circuits it, so it never executes and NO 'unsafe-eval' is required. Verified live, not assumed from the static count.

candidateC_cytoscape.a11yVerdict: FAIL for UX-DR7. A canvas renderer emits NO per-node DOM, so a roving-tabindex layer has nothing to attach to. Reaching UX-DR7 would mean building and continuously synchronising a parallel DOM overlay of focusable elements over the canvas on every pan / zoom / filter — that is writing a second renderer, not configuring around the first. Cytoscape core ships no SVG renderer mode (cytoscape-svg is an EXPORT plugin, not a live renderer).
